kicker: Page 04 ★ The Store ★ Wear the Music
title: Merch.
subhead_emphasis: From the van to the merch table to you.

description_paragraphs: Black Comfort Colors heavyweight tee. Full jukebox scene — neon lights, desert cacti, open sky. The shirt your crowd remembers you in.
Printed in small batches. Out the door by Friday.

products.name: Tour Tee 'MMXXVI'
products.desc: Black Comfort Colors. Full jukebox scene — neon, cacti, open desert. Heavyweight cotton.
products.long_description:
The 2026 Tour Tee. Heavyweight Comfort Colors black cotton, ring-spun and pre-shrunk so it stays the shape you bought it in. Full-front print: the neon jukebox glow, twin cacti, desert sky — the visual the band has been chasing since the first Friday-night room.

Printed in Central Florida in small batches. Packed at the kitchen table. Out the door by Friday.

**Fit:** True to size. Size up for a relaxed feel.
**Care:** Cold wash, inside-out, tumble dry low. The print likes that.
products.testimonial: Got it at the Lake Sumter show — softest tee I own and the print survived a hundred wash cycles. — Will P.

products.name: Ringer Tee
products.desc: Cream with black trim. Same jukebox scene. Soft heavyweight cotton.
products.long_description:
The Ringer. Cream body with black neckline and sleeve trim — the classic 70s cut, refit for shoulder-to-shoulder Friday nights. Heavyweight soft-spun cotton. Same full jukebox-scene print as the Tour Tee, in the negative.

The one you'll keep reaching for between sets and second beers.

**Fit:** True to size. Slightly trimmer through the torso.
**Care:** Cold wash, inside-out, line dry for longest life.
products.testimonial: The fit is perfect — I get compliments on this every time I wear it. — Sarah K.

products.name: Long-Sleeve Tee
products.desc: Burnt orange. White distressed Jukebox mark. Built for the cold ones after the show.
products.long_description:
Burnt-orange heavyweight long-sleeve. Distressed white Jukebox mark across the chest, cuff hits printed clean on the sleeves. Built for the after-show parking lot pour and the back-of-the-van load-out.

Printed in Central Florida, small batches.

**Fit:** True to size. Roomy through the shoulders.
**Care:** Cold wash, inside-out, tumble dry low.

products.name: Trucker Hat
products.desc: Camo foam front. Snapback. Distressed white Jukebox mark.
products.long_description:
Camo foam-front trucker with mesh back panel. Distressed white Jukebox mark on the panel. Snapback closure — one size, fits every head that's ever yelled along to a chorus.

**Fit:** Adjustable snap, fits most adults.
**Care:** Spot clean. Air dry.
products.testimonial: Wore this to ten outdoor shows last summer — still looks new. — Bryan D.

products.name: Whiskey Glass
products.desc: Brothers Jukebox rocks glass. Gothic logo. For the after-show pour.
products.long_description:
Heavyweight rocks glass, 10 oz. Etched Brothers Jukebox gothic mark on the front. Dishwasher safe but you didn't buy it to put in the dishwasher.

The glass for the slow pour after the encore.

**Care:** Hand wash recommended.

products.name: Embroidered Patch
products.desc: 3.5-inch roundel. Bucking bronco. Red, gold, white. Iron-on.
products.long_description:
3.5-inch embroidered roundel. Bucking bronco in red, gold, and white on a black field. Iron-on backing for easy application to jackets, vests, hat panels — wherever you want it.

Merit badge for the back of the dive-bar set.
products.testimonial: Stitched it on my denim jacket last week. Three people asked where I got it at the show. — Jamie R.
